scenarios.name: real_extension_unknown_runtime_upgrade
scenarios.title: Resolve an unknown released runtime before input without restarting Chrome
scenarios.workflow: Released extension without version reporting -> connect warning and unsupported window -> ordinary extension reload in the same Chrome -> reject old session and preserve original tabs -> verify loaded/bundled match -> restore real window -> trusted neutral-form input and one submission
scenarios.user_problem: A Python upgrade must reveal an unverified running extension before a login workflow, and ordinary recovery must preserve Chrome and existing tabs without replaying input.
